Lemma
[First derivatives of the square norm of a gradient]

↗ thm:levi-civita-connection ↗ lem:hessian-symmetric

Let $G=( abla f)^*$ for smooth $f$. Then $| abla f|^2$ is smooth and for vector fields $X,Y$,

  1. $Y(| abla f|^2)=2\langle abla _YG,G angle $;

  2. $( abla | abla f|^2)^*=2 abla _GG$;

  3. $\Hess (| abla f|^2)(X,Y)=2\langle abla _X abla _GG,Y angle $.

Proof

\sketch ↗ thm:levi-civita-connection ↗ lem:hessian-symmetric

Metric compatibility proves the first identity. Symmetry of the Hessian rewrites $\langle abla _YG,G angle $ as $\langle abla _GG,Y angle $, giving the gradient identity. Apply the gradient formula for the Hessian once more for the third.

□
